title: Moves you to WhatsApp or Telegram
why: Scammers move you to private chats where there are no reports and no filters. 'Sorry, wrong number' starts many romance and investment scams.
examples: Hi, sorry wrong number. You seem nice, add me on WhatsApp.
Let's move to Telegram to continue, it is more private.
safe: I will message you on WhatsApp when I reach the station.
Call me when you are free.
